_readme: Ve's file: the model, turn cap and time limit of each kind of claude session (run-loop.ps1 starts one session per job). Edit by hand; the loop only reads it. Missing or empty values fall back to the defaults in gate-rules.ps1 ($SessionDefaults). A build uses build.smallModel when its issue carries one of build.smallLabels, else build.model. run-loop.ps1 -Model / -MaxTurns override every session for one run. options.designSkills lets build and proposal sessions use the pinned design aids under D:\loop-tools (impeccable engine: context / shot / detect; ui-ux-pro-max search.py) and adds LOOP.md section 7; the runner re-hashes the engine every run and turns the feature off on a mismatch (the taste skill is never available to the loop).
